subject.title: fix(tui): deduplicate assistant messages across sessions.changed reload

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's `sessions.changed` runId surrender contract as the permanent TUI behavior for late deltas/finals after history reload?
rationale: The code appears correct, but the final merge decision owns a message-delivery/session-state tradeoff that CI cannot decide: finalized-run late finals are suppressed after reload while in-flight-run displayable finals may still render.

options.title: Accept current surrender contract
options.body: Merge after required checks because the PR uses runId-based state rather than text heuristics and covers the known late-delta/final edge cases.

options.title: Require native transport proof first
options.body: Pause merge until a maintainer or contributor supplies a native Telegram plus TUI recording for the exact reported flow.

options.title: Request an alternate reconcile path
options.body: Ask for a different implementation if maintainers do not want finalized runs to suppress all late finals after a reload.

recommendation.title: Accept current surrender contract
recommendation.body: Merge after required checks because the PR uses runId-based state rather than text heuristics and covers the known late-delta/final edge cases.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the current TUI `sessions.changed` refresh behavior that this PR refines, so he is the strongest code-history owner for the merge-risk decision.
